logp.method_description: The LogP values for 5–7 were determined using the shake-flask method and UV-vis spectroscopy. The 1-octanol used in this experiment was pre-saturated with water. An aqueous solution of 5–7 (500 μL, 100 μM) was incubated with 1-octanol (500 μL) in a 1.5 mL tube. The tube was shaken at room temperature for 2 h. The two phases were separated by centrifugation and the 5–7 content in each phase was determined by UV-vis spectroscopy.
